title: Koi Pond
tagline: Flick, swap, and watch the koi leap.
blurb: A sunlit garden pond with two ways to play: flick blooms into clusters, or swap them into rows. Play well and the golden koi leaps.
description: A garden pond in high summer: sun through the maple leaves, koi turning under the lily pads, and six kinds of bloom floating on the water. Ripples is a bubble shooter. Flick blooms from a lily pad, bank them off the sides, pop three of a kind and cut whole clusters loose before the far bank creeps down. Currents is match-three. Swap neighbours into rows, and longer matches leave behind currents that sweep a row, bursts, and a moon that clears a whole kind. Big plays send a golden koi leaping across the pond. Both modes go on through endless stages, with your best score and furthest stage kept for each.
